summary: The cited prepared source moves the sole live job-entry checkout producer from path-filtered skill-quality/semantic-skill-quality into existing unfiltered coherence/projection. Projection is in the observed native main required-check roster; source comments alone do not establish live requirement (change-completeness was not in that observed roster). No job or required context is added. Capture/report steps continue on error to preserve projection validation; missing evidence stays unavailable. The same fsgg.tested-checkout/1 artifact and one bounded reader retain exact historic skill-quality and new coherence workflow/job pairs, without duplicating metadata or activating strict default consumers. Tested checkout commit/tree, candidate head and delivered native merge remain separate; parity compares trees, not commit equality. Native PR4597/run38860185845 demonstrated that Actions can clear run.pull_requests after merge while PR head/base stay unchanged. The repaired reader requires confirmed native delivery/merge, matching branch and run identities, exact artifact joins, and native synthetic-checkout parents equal to ordered base/head before using the empty-link fallback. It validates the whole bounded link population and final head/base/branch/merge state. Malformed/conflicting links, unrelated drift, uncertain effects, tree mismatch and coherent disputes remain explicit. PR4602 qualified the repaired reader before and after native delivery using the same genuine run38862677998 and artifact12029818778; tested and delivered trees matched with all eight required checks passing. The universal producer migration remains prepared source; local fixtures and that reader acceptance do not establish universal hosted deployment, every-job checkout coverage, installed adoption or speedup. Existing population/byte bounds and producer-install exclusion remain unchanged. The coherence workflow itself is selected by both skill-quality PR/push path filters so future producer edits run the invariant fixtures.
title: One universal PR checkout producer retains native merged-run correspondence
